svg.title: Patapon decompilation progress map
svg.desc: Rectangle area is code bytes of BOOT.BIN. Grey: still assembly. Mid green: matching C with names left to find. Light green: every name in its body is ours. The bar below places the game code beside Sony's libraries. Open the file to hover each function.
